query:
SELECT DISTINCT d.host_chain_id, d.handle,
                   d.consensus_epoch = $1 AS "local!"
           FROM public.drifted_handle d
           WHERE d.reason = 'ct64_mismatch' AND d.healed_at IS NULL
             AND (d.consensus_epoch = $1
                  OR ($2 AND NOT EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM ciphertexts ct WHERE ct.handle = d.handle))
                  OR (d.local_ct64_digest IS NOT NULL
                      AND EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM ciphertext_digest cd
                           WHERE cd.handle = d.handle
                             AND cd.ciphertext = d.local_ct64_digest)))
